items.title: Investors Are Excited About European Stocks. This Europe ETF is Up 23% in 1 Year. Here's Why.
items.summary: European stocks are experiencing a boom, with the iShares Core MSCI Europe ETF (IEUR) up 23% in the past year, driven by better earnings, lower oil prices, and the spread of the AI trade. While this ETF offers diversification from U.S. tech stocks and a strong dividend yield of 3.11%, it has historically underperformed the S&P 500. Investors should consider their long-term outlook for European economic growth when evaluating this investment.

items.title: Fastenal Stock Climbs 14% in a Month: Buy the High Now or Wait?
items.summary: Fastenal (FAST) stock has risen 14% in the past month, outperforming its industry and the S&P 500, driven by strong Q2 2026 results with increased earnings and sales. The company's growth is attributed to technology-driven customer relationships, favorable pricing, and strong demand, despite challenges like unfavorable price-cost dynamics and inflation. While Fastenal shows strong prospects, its premium valuation and near-term margin pressures suggest investors might want to wait for a more attractive entry point, earning it a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.title: Corning Inc Stock (GLW) Moved Up by 5.69% on Aug 17: Key Drivers Unveiled
items.summary: Corning Inc (GLW) stock rose by 5.69% on August 17, driven primarily by high demand for its optical communications infrastructure due to AI data center expansion. The company's localized manufacturing strategy has insulated it from trade tariffs, and strong quarterly earnings with robust revenue and profit margins further boosted investor confidence. Analysts have responded favorably to management's optimistic outlook and long-term strategy, highlighting Corning's strong execution across its segments.

items.title: Iran war costing CAE millions of dollars, as it drastically reduces global footprint
items.summary: CAE Inc. is facing significant financial setbacks due to the Middle East war, which cost the company millions in its latest quarter and is forcing a drastic reduction in its global footprint. The company's CEO, Matthew Bromberg, announced plans to shed 1.7 million square feet of space and retire or relocate a significant number of full-flight simulators, aiming to lower expenses amidst rising fuel costs and decreased demand for pilot training. Despite these challenges, CAE surpassed analyst expectations for adjusted earnings, and long-term fundamentals for pilot training are viewed positively.

items.title: ‘Gold has been in a bull market for 25 Years’ – Morgan Stanley CIO Wilson
items.summary: Morgan Stanley CIO Mike Wilson states that gold has been in a bull market for 25 years and serves as a crucial defensive asset, particularly in environments where traditional 60/40 portfolios fail. He emphasizes gold's role alongside other commodities in providing diversification and hedging against inflation, especially given the current economic landscape where bonds offer less protection. Despite recent struggles, Morgan Stanley maintains a long-term bullish outlook on gold, reiterating a $5,200 per ounce target, although ETF demand and Federal Reserve policies remain key factors influencing its short-term performance.

items.title: Precious Metals StoneX Bullion weekly round-up; Indian silver licences issued
items.summary: The StoneX Bullion weekly round-up discusses the performance of precious metals, noting that gold and silver found buoyancy despite weak US retail sales, partially due to seasonal factors and a weakening dollar. A significant development for the silver market is the issuance of import licenses in India, which is expected to stabilize prices and allow jewelers to build inventory for the upcoming wedding season. The report also touches on technical indicators for gold and silver, the impact of US tariffs on polysilicon products affecting silver demand, and ETF activity for both metals.

items.title: Lululemon Athletica stock holds around $119 as guidance weighs on sentiment
items.summary: Lululemon Athletica's stock is trading around $119, with investors reacting coolly to its Q1 earnings, which showed modest revenue growth but softer full-year earnings guidance. The stock is down over 40% year-to-date in 2026 and more than 75% from its 2023 peak, indicating a significant de-rating despite continued demand for its products. The market is now focused on how the company will manage to improve profitability and close the performance gap relative to the broader market.

items.title: Marvell Shares Surge 7.5%, Market Value Rises $14.6 Billion Ahead of Earnings
items.summary: Marvell Technology shares surged 7.5%, increasing its market value by $14.6 billion, driven by investor anticipation of strong AI networking demand ahead of its fiscal second-quarter earnings report. The stock's current valuation, at 25.5 times projected fiscal 2026 revenue, sets a high bar for the upcoming earnings announcement. Analysts maintain a positive outlook, with an average price target of $269.85, but options markets are pricing in a significant 14% swing around the earnings release.
